clauses.reason: whole: EO 12095 (signed 1978-11-02, 43 FR 51595) creates an emergency board under Section 44 of the Airline Deregulation Act of 1978 to investigate the dispute between Wien Air Alaska, Inc. and certain individuals represented by the Air Line Pilots Association. The order's commands are the establishment of the board ("1-101. Establishment o f  Board.") and the thirty-day report command ("1-102. Report."). First end: EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17, 47 FR 36099), whose preamble states that it is made "to terminate the establishing authorities for" committees that are inactive or no longer necessary and whose Sec. 5 reads "Sec. 5. Executive Order No. 12095, creating an Em ergency Board to Investigate" (the sentence continues on the next lines and ends "is revoked."). EO 12379 has no effective-date wording, so the revocation is read as effective on signing, 1982-08-17. The Office of the Federal Register catalog note reads "Revoked by: EO 12379, August 17, 1982". The held source-ladder and family-rule texts filed under other order numbers (for example queue_EO_11022, queue_EO_11256 and queue_EO_11829) are reprints of the same 47 FR 36099 pages of EO 12379; the dossier's chain events dated 1962, 1965 and 1975 that cite them for this order come from those mislabeled files and are not events.
